opening.text: 雪だるまの間違い探し、全5問。

unchiku.text: ここでひと休み。こよみ先生の季節のお話です。
雪の朝は、なぜ外がしんと静かなのでしょう？
答えは、ふわふわの雪が、まわりの音を吸いこむから。
雪の朝は、耳をすましてみてくださいね。

ending.text: これで5問、おしまいです。
15個の違い、いくつ見つかりましたか。今日の称号です。
チャンネル登録とベルで、毎朝8時半に問題が届きます。毎日の頭の体操にどうぞ。
次は、右の動画、冬の鍋料理の回もどうぞ。湯気の絵で、もう5問。

extra.text: 見つかった数を、あとでコメントで教えてくださいね。

readings: ゆきうさぎのえんがわ
ゆきうさぎのみみのは
ゆきだるまとふゆのあさ

images.style: A Japanese picture-book illustration in watercolor, but with BOLD, THICK, DARK ink outlines around every object (like a clear picture book for seniors), and CLEAR, SATURATED colors (not pale). Bright, clean background. Natural, hand-drawn, slightly rounded shapes; not geometric, not flat vector, not photorealistic. CLOSE-UP composition (not a wide landscape): the scene is seen from close, filling the picture. PORTRAIT-ISH composition, about 8:9. The painting fills the entire canvas edge to edge: no white border. No people. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere. The MAIN SUBJECT named in the scene is drawn LARGE in the center of the picture. Around it, only a few other objects, each clearly separated with space around it, fully visible. Natural daylight with a neutral, clean white balance (soft cool-white winter daylight; NOT warm, NOT orange, NOT reddish; snow is clean white or pale blue-gray). Shop awnings, curtains, banners, lanterns, bags and boxes are plain and blank: no writing, no signboards with letters, no logos.
images.keep_alt: Keep everything else in the picture exactly the same: same composition, same position of every object, same colors, same style. Do not add or remove anything else. Leave no faint outline, ghost or smudge. No text.
images.keep_remove: Where an object is removed, fill the area naturally with what would be behind it, and leave no faint outline, ghost or smudge of the removed object.
